_comment: The schema render.py consumes, filled with a real planning session so the
example is checkable rather than decorative. Every figure was quoted on
2026-08-03, in one run — quoting candidates on different days measures the
search date, not the trip (Method rule 3).
Note what is NOT here: a fourth candidate (Orlando -> Miami -> New York)
existed in that session. Two of its internal legs were re-quoted after the
numbers below were captured, and reconstructing them would mean typing a
figure nobody measured. Method rule 10 says say so instead. So it is absent,
Fields the renderer DERIVES, so do not fight it: window nights, each
candidate's night count, and which candidates can attend each event.
Fields it ASSERTS: flights_total and lodging_total against their parts.
